description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 scores between two different tokenization methods for materials data, as a function of the number of tokens used. The x-axis represents the number of tokens, ranging from 0.6 to 1.5, with a linear scale and no units specified. The y-axis shows the Macro-F1 score percentage, ranging from 48% to 56%, also with a linear scale and no units. The plot features two lines: one in pink representing the "MATTER (ours)" method, and one in purple representing the "w/o material information" method. The pink line starts at approximately 54% for 0.6 tokens, peaks at around 56% for 0.8 tokens, and then fluctuates before ending at about 51% for 1.5 tokens. The purple line begins at roughly 52% for 0.6 tokens, shows a slight increase to about 53% for 0.8 tokens, and then generally declines to around 48% for 1.5 tokens. The plot includes markers at each data point, with the pink line having a solid line style and the purple line having a dashed line style.
